ui.help.air_b: A hit destroys an aircraft; hardpoints allow several shots per turn (max 3). Fuel burns every turn — return to a working airbase or carrier or the aircraft crashes when dry. Profiles: patrol (radar/air-to-air bonus, fuel ×1.3), ferry (fuel ×0.5, mobility +25%, no firing).
ui.help.asat_b: On the situation tab, click an enemy satellite to launch an ASAT strike; click an enemy airbase or port to strike its structure. Facilities below 25 percent integrity stop working.
ui.help.ctrl1: LMB: select own unit / pick target / move
ui.help.ctrl4: Arrows: move keyboard cursor (auto-scroll near edges)
ui.help.ctrl5: Enter: select / move / pick target at cursor, Enter again to fire
ui.help.ctrl8: R: radar　J: jam　E: overlay　F5/F9: quick save/load　F10: menu
ui.help.cue_b: With tracking data from a neighbouring radar or AEW aircraft, a platform can fire without its own lock; with a datalink there is no penalty (A fires, B guides), legacy equipment gets ×0.78 accuracy.
ui.help.edit_b: The map/weapon editor on the main menu edits terrain, size, facilities, deployment, unit stats, ammunition and loadout presets; the deployment page can filter by preset formation.
ui.help.ew_b: Jamming suppresses radar links and degrades satellite navigation; anti-radiation missiles only hit emitters. EW units can drop decoys that appear as false targets on the enemy picture — attacking one wastes a whole shot.
ui.help.inf_b: Infantry takes less damage from direct fire and more from area fire, and defends best in cities. Holding still builds field works that add protection and reduce detection; moving loses them.
ui.help.recon_b: A target must be tracked by sensors before firing data can be set; guns and rocket artillery can suppress a merely classified target.
ui.help.salvo_b: The engagement panel offers 1-3 round salvos: each round rolls separately, hit chance is combined, but ammunition is spent accordingly.
ui.help.save_b: The system menu has 5 slots and stores unit states, munitions in flight, facility damage and objective ownership.

ui.menu.feat_aa_desc: Layered air defence intercepts incoming munitions independently with pooled probability; hypersonic and stealthy rounds can still break through.
ui.menu.feat_ew_desc: Jamming suppresses radars and guidance links and degrades satellite navigation; anti-radiation missiles hunt emitting radars.
ui.menu.feat_recon_desc: A target must be tracked by sensors before a firing solution exists; if intel breaks, even advanced munitions are wasted.
ui.menu.feat_space_desc: Satellites pass overhead every 3 turns; GNSS integrity directly sets the accuracy of guided munitions.
ui.menu.feat_standoff_desc: Long-range rounds have flight time — a manoeuvring target or broken intel mid-flight means a miss.
ui.menu.side_blue_desc: Combined force: networked reconnaissance and standoff precision strike
ui.menu.side_red_desc: Area denial: long-range air defence and saturation anti-ship strikes
